summary.en: Write the test before the code

description.zh:
在写实现代码前先写会失败的测试，用红-绿-重构推进功能与修复。
包含如何写出好的测试与常见反模式。
适合任何新功能或 bug 修复。
description.en:
Write a failing test first, then implement, using red-green-refactor for features and fixes.
Covers how to write good tests and common anti-patterns.
Works for any new feature or bug fix.
